title: Fenerbahce repeat as Basketball Super League champions
description: Fenerbahce - Besiktas 84-68 Fenerbahce defended their Basketball Super League title. They knocked down Besiktas in the fifth game of the championship series to capture the trophy. Nigel Hayes-Davis (203-F-1994, college: Wisconsin) came up with 16 points to pace the champions. Fenerbahce snatched a 21-18 lead after the opening quarter. They sank 27 points in the second stanza to gain a 48-40 halftime lead. Fenerbahce continued their dominance in the second half. They held Besiktas to just 14 points in the third frame to boost the lead to 15 points. Fenerbahce limited their cross-town rivals to just 14 points in the fourth final stanza and raced to the triumph. Wade Baldwin IV (193-G-1996, college: Vanderbilt) produced 13 points for Fenerbahce. Jonah Mathews (191-SG-1998, college: USC) replied with 19 points for Besiktas. Derek Needham (180-PG-1990, college: Fairfield) tossed in 14 points…
